description: K on a fight-target decision with TWO engaged enemies (Gretchin moved beside Trajann): the card ranks both targets, explains 'Why not' the runner-up from their itemised fight scores.

steps.script:
AIDecisionMaker.set_ai_seed(7)
return AIDecisionMaker.is_ai_seeded()
steps.comment: seed the AI's score noise so the fight order (and so which unit/target is reached) is the same every run

steps.script: AIPlayer.configure({1: "HUMAN", 2: "HUMAN"})
main.refresh_ai_suggestion_button()

steps.comment: Setup: put Gretchin squad C in base contact range beside Trajann so he is engaged with TWO units (Boyz + Gretchin) and the fight-target card has two options
steps.script:
var H = load("res://tests/helpers/cus11e_c5_scen.gd")
var c := Vector2.ZERO
var n := 0
for m in GameState.state.units.U_TRAJANN_A.models:
	if m.get("position") != null:
		c += Vector2(float(m.position.x), float(m.position.y))
		n += 1
c /= float(max(n, 1))
H.move_to("U_GRETCHIN_C", c.x / 40.0 + 2.2, c.y / 40.0)
PhaseManager.transition_to_phase(10)
return true
